name: United States
tipping: Restaurants: 18–22% expected on the pre-tax bill
Prices are shown before sales tax
etiquette: Queue properly and keep a little personal space
Service staff rely on tips as part of their wages
avoid: Not tipping is seen as a strong complaint, not a neutral choice
water: Tap water is safe to drink across almost all of the country.
scams: Fake "charity" or CD sellers in Times Square
Costumed characters asking for money after a photo

driving.speedLimits: 25–35 mph in town, 55–75 mph on highways (varies by state)
driving.mustCarry: Nothing extra required. Rental cars include the essentials
notes: Turning right on a red light is usually allowed after a full stop, but not in New York City
Never pass a school bus with its stop sign out
Most rental firms accept a UK licence. An IDP is recommended

medicines: Keep medicines in their original labelled containers with a copy of the prescription. Some medicines sold over the counter in the UK are prescription-only in the US.
entry: ESTA approved before you fly (apply only on the official US government site)
Passport valid for your whole stay
